content: दायः [दा भावे-घञ्] .²1 A gift, present, donation; रहसि रमते प्रीत्या दायं ददात्यनुवर्तते <ls>Māl. 3. 2</ls>; प्रीतिदायः <ls>Māl. 4</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 199</ls>. .²2 A nuptial present (given to the bride or the bridegroom). .²3 Share, portion, inheritance, patrimony; अनपत्यस्य पुत्रस्य माता दायमवाप्नुयात् <ls>Ms. 9. 217</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 9.">77</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 9.">164</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 9.">203</ls>. .²4 A part or share in general. .²5 Delivering, handing over. .²6 Dividing, distributing. .²7 Loss, destruction. .²8 Irony. .²9 Site, place. .²10 Alms given to a student at his initiation, <ab>&c.</ab> .²11 A relative or a kinsman; तेलङ्गदायसहिता निष्पेतुरहिते तदा <ls>Parṇāl. 5. 79</ls>.
